cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the laptop shut. I've decided you're hearing why I haven't booked our anniversary trip before you start fixing the flights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought that was all you needed help with.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I allowed you to think that. Here's the first correction: I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep it shut. Is this about the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That question is allowed. Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Stay beside me while I give you the rest; I need to know you can hear it and still stay.

heightening.evidence: B4 willingness and direct question unlock A5 more consequential truth and a renewed request that support remain.
